name: Herdr
description: Install Herdr and bridge its pane socket(s) in from the Docker host over SSH

version.description: Select or enter a Herdr version to install

bridge.description: Bridge the host's HERDR_SOCKET_PATH Unix socket into the container over SSH, so hooks / plugins that report agent state can reach it. Needed on Docker Desktop / OrbStack-style setups, where the host's Unix socket file isn't reachable through a bind mount. Requires Remote Login (sshd) enabled on the host and remoteUser set.

remoteUser.description: The username to SSH into for the socket bridge. Leave empty to disable the bridge even if `bridge` is true.

remoteHost.description: Hostname of the Docker host, reachable from inside the container

privateKeyPath.description: Path inside the container where a dedicated bridge SSH private key would be bind-mounted, IF you use one. Optional: if no file exists at this path when the container starts, ssh runs without -i and falls back to whatever auth is otherwise available (e.g. an agent forwarded via SSH_AUTH_SOCK). Re-checked on every reconnect attempt, not just once at container start.
